title: Order of Battle & Units (preserved)
subtitle: Your handwritten OOB, units, division templates and equipment are kept verbatim and re-exported byte-for-byte.
editHelp: Edit freely — this exact text is written into history/countries/[TAG].txt on export. Comments and inline blocks are kept as-is.
emptyBody: Paste a set_oob reference or a units block here and it survives export unchanged. set_oob names a file under history/units/: the program generates that file from your Division Templates and Starting Army workbenches, and a file of the same name that came in with an imported mod is carried over untouched. Name it country tag + start year (e.g. ROM_1936) — everything downstream reads the country from that prefix.
starterComment: # Order of Battle — written verbatim into this country's history file
starterNeedsTag: Set this history file's country tag first — the OOB file name must start with it (e.g. ROM_1936), otherwise nothing can tell which country these units belong to.
